rows: You're good on the deck. You'll have to put me there first.
Hard hitter, you are. I didn't come here for a single forearm.
Get up there if you want. I'll be here when you come down.
Stop making a meal of it. We've got a match to do.
Those people bought a ticket for a fight. Give them the whole thing.
Nothing clever to say. Watch us when the bell goes.
Put this match anywhere you like. It'll be the one they remember.
Have a look. That's the bloke you've got to get through.
Then defend the takedown. Don't just talk about it.
Take the first one and tell me what it's worth.
You'll be doing well if you catch me before I land.
I'm taking my time. Come and make me hurry.
I'll do my part. See that you do yours.
You're on the card. Same as me. Let's see the wrestling.
Your {strength}. Fine. That's what I've got to get through.
I know what you can do with those {strength}. I'll have to answer them.
No problem with you. Just want to beat you.
Save the shouting. See you in the ring.
I've had enough of this argument. Let's go and wrestle.
One fall, Red's way. Just us.
Get on the mat with me, then.
Stay inside the ropes when it gets hard.
Right. That's all I needed to hear.
It'll be hard. I'm still winning.
I will come out on top.
Clean fall in the middle. No messing about.
I've got something for you. Wait for the bell.
Fair. Can't prove that one. Forget it.
No example to give you. I'm here to wrestle, not make one up.
Right. That's done. Get in the ring.
Good. Leave it there and fight me.
Who stays on their feet, who gets the fall. They'll see it.
Get in there and make me work for it. No need for a story around it.
Leave the rumour alone. What can we show them when the bell goes?
We've talked enough. What can the crowd see for themselves in the ring?
You've got a way round my {strength}, have you? Right. Try it when the bell goes.
You've talked enough about my {strength}. I'll use them, you try stopping them. Simple.
Fair. Can't prove it? Leave it.
You're right on that. The crowd can see for themselves when we get out there.
You've been around. Good. You'll still have to wrestle me.
Years on the job don't mean you get the easy shift tonight.
Experience tells me when a bloke's trying to draw me in. I don't have to bite.
Learned to keep my feet and save my breath. Come on, then.
